videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: With only days left to qualify, Elena urges Arturo to coach Blu, who must confront the shadows of her past before she can race toward her future.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Elena is cut off from the family estate and scrambles for help. The competition heats up as Blu and rival Paolo go head-to-head off the racecourse.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A figure from Blu's past resurfaces with an unexpected request. The SC17 team runs on fumes as Elena places a risky bet that could change their future.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Elena's team suits up for a turbocharged plan to secure their finances, but Blu uncovers something from the past that could jeopardize it all.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After an accident derails the squad, Blu faces the fallout from recent discoveries. The SC17 team must rely on faith to triumph in their final race.
